def load_weather(path):
    # NOTE: this is slow on the big file, cache it later
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df = df.dropna(subset=["zone"])
    return df


def summarise_weather(df):
    out = df.groupby("zone").size()
    print(f"got {len(out)} groups")
    return out
